title: Your First Weekend at Florida Southern College, Shared as Cards
description: A Friday-to-Sunday introduction to FSC traditions, campus resources, Wright architecture, recreation, dining, and nearby Lakeland culture.

cards.title: Friday: Start With Something Red
cards.subtitle: Join FSC’s weekly Friday spirit tradition
cards.notes: Wear red while settling in, then check Engage for any scheduled campus activities that fit the rest of your Friday.
cards.short_summary: A simple, documented way to participate in campus life from the first day.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern states that every Friday is Red Shirt Friday and invites community members to wear red; its campus-lingo guide directs students to Engage for campus events.
cards.access_notes: Participation depends on being on campus on Friday; prizes are described as possible, not guaranteed.

cards.title: Friday Dinner: Learn the Main Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Find the heart-of-campus dining option
cards.notes: Use dinner to learn the serving layout and meal-plan process; review the live portal before going because hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A practical first meal that makes later campus dining easier to navigate.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern identifies Wynee’s Bistro as a dining location in the heart of campus and lists weekend breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.access_notes: The FSC portal currently lists Saturday–Sunday breakfast/lunch from 8:00 AM–1:30 PM and dinner from 4:30–8:00 PM; verify live hours.

cards.entity_name: Marshall and Vera Lea Rinker Technology Center
cards.title: Friday Evening: Test Your Tech Setup
cards.subtitle: Confirm logins, printing, and study tools early
cards.notes: Bring your laptop and student credentials, test essential accounts, and note where to return if a course platform fails.
cards.short_summary: An early systems check can prevent avoidable problems once coursework begins.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern says the Rinker Technology Center supports coursework and collaboration and provides PCs, Macs, printers, and scanners.
cards.access_notes: Standard lab hours list Friday 8:00 AM–9:00 PM; summer hours are Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM. Check which schedule applies.

cards.title: Saturday Morning: Try the Waterfront
cards.subtitle: Use FSC’s Lake Hollingsworth recreation program
cards.notes: Take your FSC ID, sign the required waiver, follow the attendant’s instructions, and keep your life jacket on while afloat.
cards.short_summary: A supervised introduction to FSC recreation directly across from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC’s Waterfront is open Friday through Sunday during the academic year and offers students free kayak and paddleboard checkout with an FSC ID and waiver.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Friday–Sunday operation only; an FSC ID and signed waiver are required, and life jackets must remain on while on the water.

cards.title: Saturday Midday: See the Water Dome
cards.subtitle: Observe a centerpiece of Wright’s campus plan
cards.notes: Photograph the fountain from outside its basin and look for the circular jet arrangement; never enter the water without an official event.
cards.short_summary: A close look at one of the campus’s most recognizable Wright-designed features.
cards.evidence_claim: The college archives describe the Water Dome as a Frank Lloyd Wright-designed fountain with 75 jets capable of sending water 45 feet into the air.
cards.access_notes: Viewing is appropriate, but entering the basin is prohibited except during an authorized college event such as Senior Splash.

cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: Decode the Wright Campus
cards.subtitle: Begin at the official interpretive hub
cards.notes: Reserve at least a day ahead if you want a guided tour, then report to the GEICO Gift Shop at 840 Johnson Avenue.
cards.short_summary: The visitor center supplies context for the architecture encountered across campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern identifies the Sharp Family Tourism and Education Center as the interpretive hub for its Wright campus and the departure point for guided walking tours.
cards.access_notes: Visitor Center hours are daily 9:30 AM–4:30 PM. Reservations are strongly suggested at least 24 hours before a tour; tour tickets require purchase.

cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: Examine Wright’s Usonian Idea
cards.subtitle: Continue beside the Visitor Center
cards.notes: Check the current admission arrangement before entering and compare the compact house with FSC’s larger academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A residential-scale counterpart to the monumental structures elsewhere on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern says the Tourism and Education Center includes the Usonian Faculty House, a showcase of Frank Lloyd Wright’s residential vision for the campus.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily Usonian House hours of 10:00 AM–3:00 PM; confirm tour or admission requirements before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ashley Gibson Barnett Museum of Art
cards.title: Saturday Gallery Break: Visit the AGB
cards.subtitle: Explore FSC’s museum near Lake Morton
cards.notes: Choose a few galleries rather than rushing the entire museum, and check entrance signs before photographing any artwork.
cards.short_summary: A free cultural stop connecting the college with Lakeland’s wider community.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that general admission is free and lists regular Saturday hours from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions — The Ashley Gibson Barnett Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Regular Saturday hours are 10:00 AM–4:00 PM. Photography is allowed in many galleries, but visitors must follow gallery signs.

cards.title: Saturday Late Afternoon: Walk Hollis Garden
cards.subtitle: Add a city garden to the campus-focused day
cards.notes: Walk the formal beds and fountains at an unhurried pace, respect any rental closure, and leave enough time to exit before closing.
cards.short_summary: A structured botanical walk within Lakeland’s historic Lake Mirror Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lakeland describes Hollis Garden as a 1.2-acre botanical display garden in Lake Mirror Park with patterned beds, public art, fountains, and more than 10,000 flowers.
cards.access_notes: June–August hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Tuesday–Sunday; the garden is closed Mondays. Friday and Saturday rentals may affect access after 6:00 PM.

cards.title: Sunday Evening: Set Up Your Study Base
cards.subtitle: Finish the weekend by locating library resources
cards.notes: Find a preferred study zone, save the librarian contact details, and identify the café and group areas before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A low-pressure orientation to the campus’s main research and study facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern says Roux Library provides extensive research resources, librarian appointments, group-study seating, meeting rooms, and casual seating.
cards.access_notes: Posted summer hours currently show Sunday closed; academic-term hours may differ. Consult the library’s live hours before making this the Sunday stop.

warnings: Campus dining, library, technology-center, museum, waterfront, and garden schedules vary by academic term, summer season, holidays, or special events; verify the linked pages before setting out.
The Waterfront is limited to eligible FSC community members and requires an FSC ID, waiver, and compliance with safety rules.
The Water Dome is for viewing only unless Florida Southern expressly authorizes entry during an official event.
